videos.titleEn: Thy Tran on Micron’s 1-Alpha DRAM Process Technology

videos.scope: Micron 的 1α 世代歷史案例；不把當時的最先進宣傳用語當成目前全球排名。
videos.scopeEn: Historical Micron 1-alpha example; contemporary leading-edge marketing is not treated as a current global ranking.
watchFor: 記錄設計、製程、產品與測試的合作介面。
區分密度、效能與品質指標。
尋找可驗證的工程證據與宣傳敘述的差別。
watchForEn: Record interfaces among design, process, product and test teams.
Separate density, performance and quality metrics.
Distinguish testable engineering evidence from marketing statements.
videos.before: 先列出 DRAM 儲存、保持與讀出的必要功能。
videos.beforeEn: List required DRAM storage, retention and readout functions.
videos.after: 提出兩項量測，檢查密度提升是否伴隨代價。
videos.afterEn: Propose two measurements to check trade-offs accompanying density improvement.

videos.title: 晶片如何製成？ASML Nanoland 第 6 集
videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「先進製程控制與虛擬量測」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Advanced process control and virtual metrology. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「閉迴路邊界：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Closed-loop boundary: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「域外偵測：建立模型」列為查證任務：域外資料可能使小殘差歷史失效；新材料可能需要完全不同映射。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Out-of-domain detection: construct and analyze: Out-of-domain data can invalidate good historical residuals; New materials may require different mappings.

courses.overview: 從「先進製程控制與虛擬量測」延伸比較製程統計管制系統、化學機械平坦化：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Advanced process control and virtual metrology by comparing Statistical process-control systems and Chemical mechanical planarization: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: SPC 與 APC／虛擬量測都以時間序列監控製程，漂移、延遲與資料版本會影響決策。
related.transferEn: SPC and APC/virtual metrology both use process time series, with drift, delay and data versions affecting decisions.
related.difference: SPC 主要判斷統計穩定與調查；APC 會調整輸入，虛擬量測則預測未量值。預測不能自動當成實測閉環依據。
related.differenceEn: SPC primarily assesses stability and investigation; APC changes inputs, while virtual metrology predicts unmeasured values. Predictions are not automatically physical measurements.
practice: 分開監控警報、預測及控制動作三條流程。
用時間切分驗證模型，避免未來資料洩漏。
訂定漂移時恢復實體量測與人工審查的門檻。
practiceEn: Separate monitoring alarms, predictions and control actions.
Validate with temporal splits to avoid future-data leakage.
Define drift thresholds for physical metrology and human review.
related.title: 製程統計管制系統

related.why: SPC 與 APC／虛擬量測都以時間序列監控製程，漂移、延遲與資料版本會影響決策。
related.whyEn: SPC and APC/virtual metrology both use process time series, with drift, delay and data versions affecting decisions.

related.transfer: CMP 厚度可作為虛擬量測／R2R 控制案例，將設備訊號與真實膜厚配對分析漂移。
related.transferEn: CMP thickness is a virtual-metrology/run-to-run example, pairing tool signals with measured thickness to analyze drift.
related.difference: CMP 是材料去除過程；預測模型只是對它的估計。保養或漿料改變後，原模型與控制增益未必仍適用。
related.differenceEn: CMP is material removal; a model estimates it. Maintenance or slurry changes may invalidate the model and control gain.
practice: 配對每片設備時間窗與厚度量測。
用保養前訓練、保養後驗證檢查分布轉移。
限制失準模型的回授，保留實體抽樣。
practiceEn: Pair each wafer tool-time window with thickness measurements.
Train before maintenance and validate afterward for distribution shift.
Limit feedback from a degraded model and retain physical sampling.
related.title: 化學機械平坦化

courses.summary: 本課以「NIST 量測研究參考園區」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從閉迴路邊界、時間切割到版本回復：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses NIST metrology-research reference campus as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Closed-loop boundary and Temporal splitting to Version rollback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
